name: Airpod Battery Monitor
description:
Note: This extension has been deprecated in favour of Gnome extension Bluetooth Battery Meter.

https://extensions.gnome.org/extension/6670/bluetooth-battery-meter/

Use Bluetooth Battery Meter for battery level reading and ANC control.

A Gnome extension for monitoring battery level of AirPods and Beats Bluetooth headset

Note: This extension is not compatible with Bluetooth configurations in BR/EDR-only mode. Dual mode is required. Please refer to the Readme documentation for more information.

https://maniacx.github.io/Airpod-Battery-Monitor/
